description: This file defines a helper class 'ClassHelper' within the 'OrangeHRM\Core\Helper' namespace. The class provides methods for checking class existence, retrieving class names with optional fallback namespaces, and verifying if a class or object implements specific interfaces.

classes.name: ClassHelper
classes.description: A helper class offering utility methods to interact with PHP classes, including existence checks, name resolution with fallback namespaces, and interface implementation verification.

methods.name: classExists
methods.description: Checks if a class exists, considering an optional fallback namespace.

methods.name: getClass
methods.description: Retrieves the fully qualified class name, trying an optional fallback namespace if the class is not found.

methods.name: hasClassImplements
methods.description: Checks whether a given class or object implements the specified interfaces.
